```{ojs}
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT #1: bcv_parser
import { bcv_parser } from "./bcv_parser.js"; // this is native bcv_parser

// IMPORT#2: default language tables directly here
import { grammar_options, regexps, translations } from "./lang/en.js"

// bcv_parser INSTANCE to with language to be used as such or passed further 
bcv = new bcv_parser({grammar_options, regexps, translations})
//bcv.parse("John 1.1 KJV").osis_and_translations()

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// or passed further to SUPER RefEngine2
import { RefEngine, monobloc } from "./refengine.js";

engine = new RefEngine(bcv);

import { bsInput } from "./refui_sole.js";

  viewof ref = new bsInput({
    prefixHTML: "<i class='bi bi-book'></i>",
    placeholder: "Enter reference",
    addLabel: "Add",
    resetLabel: "RAZ",
//    transform: (txt, prev) => txt
    transform: (txt, prev) => engine.transform(txt, prev)
  }).node();

   ref; // {osis, previousOsis, url_fetchable, response{..., duration,content}}//
   ref.response ?  ref.response.map((request)=> request.content_array) : "waiting for input";           // current OSIS
//  ref.value.osis           // current OSIS
//  ref.value.previousOsis   // previous OSIS
//  ref.value.url_fetchable  // non-null only when OSIS changed
//  ref.value.data           // fetched JSON (only when OSIS changed)

// works OK at least on first one
restyle = {
  // Wait until OJS inserts it into the DOM
  const container = viewof ref;
//  const group = container.querySelector("div.input-group");
  
  const allButtons = container.querySelectorAll("button");

  queueMicrotask(() => {
   allButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.classList.remove("btn-quarto");
      console.log("Hey")
    });
  });
} // end of restyle  

```
